about: The whole video, second cut: the mechanic and Amazon's requirements first. Add-on lines word for word from a run of the fixed Household Orders build with a $40 permission (src/data/consent-fixed.json).

lines.text: Over twenty thousand people signed up for this hackathon.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words.

lines.text: Somebody has to check all of that. That's you.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words. Playful wink on 'That's you'.

lines.text: So I built something for you.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words. Warm.

lines.text: This is Hearsay. Write what your customers say. Hearsay plays it against your add-on, mishearings included, and fails the build when it would sound wrong.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words. A confident reveal on 'This is Hearsay'.

lines.text: Here's how it works. When someone talks to your add-on, Amazon turns the speech into text, and the assistant's model picks your tool. Only the next step is your code.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words.

and the assistant's model picks your tool.
Only the next step is your code.

lines.text: So Hearsay plays those two parts from your test case. The customer says fifteen, your tool gets fifteen. And because speech recognition slips, it tries fifty too.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words.

lines.text: Then it checks what your add-on really answers. No microphone, no model, no network. The same result every time, so it runs in CI.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words.
parts: Then it checks what your add-on really answers.
No microphone, no model, no network.
The same result every time, so it runs in CI.

lines.text: Every finding cites the rule it breaks, and most are Amazon's published requirements for add-ons.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words.

lines.text: A tool answers within half a second. A reply stays under thirty seconds. No JSON read aloud. At most five options. And no payment without a question that names what and how much.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words. A short beat between the five rules.
parts: A tool answers within half a second.
A reply stays under thirty seconds.
And no payment without a question that names what and how much.

lines.text: Hearsay is unofficial, and it doesn't certify anything. It just tells you early.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words. Honest, light.

lines.text: Here's a grocery add-on, with Hearsay playing its customer.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words.

lines.text: Fifteen is heard as fifty, and the add-on just says: added. The customer says no, and the order changes anyway.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words.

lines.text: Twenty errors. The pull request fails.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words. Short and dry.

lines.text: Same tests, fixed build. The customer grants a budget once, and money only moves after a yes.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words.

lines.text: You can reorder groceries up to forty dollars today.
lines.direction: A regular person talking to a smart speaker at home. Natural and relaxed, brisk everyday pace.

lines.text: Yes.

lines.text: Add fifteen dollars of fruit.

lines.text: That would go over the total budget you gave me. You can add less, or give me a bigger budget.

lines.text: Zero errors. Green.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words. Satisfied, short.

lines.text: You don't even have to run it yourself. Hearsay is also an MCP server, so your coding agent runs it, fixes what it finds, and checks again until it's green.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words.

lines.text: And it can't cheat. Your suite is locked, and Hearsay keeps test cases your agent never sees.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words. Firm on 'it can't cheat'.

lines.text: We measured it.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words. Serious, short.

lines.text: A suite alone made agents stop at green. So Hearsay now shows what your suite doesn't cover.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words.

lines.text: Result: as good as a precise prompt on unseen cases, better on the rules nobody told the agent about, and zero defects left behind.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words. Proud but measured.

lines.text: It runs in CI, without API keys, and fails the pull request before your customers ever hear it.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words.

lines.text: Hearsay is open source. Point it at your server.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words. Warm, inviting finish.
